figurative_meaning_en: To shop around for items by wandering from place to place
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে গস্ত করে সেরা দামে জিনিস কিনো।
example_sentences_in_english: He went to the big market to do some shopping around.
Shop around in the market to get the best price.
note: This idiom is commonly used in rural or semi-urban Bengali contexts to describe leisurely market browsing.
